from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance

def brightness_augment(img_path, factor=1.2):
    with Image.open(img_path) as img:
        enhancer = ImageEnhance.Brightness(img)
        brightened = enhancer.enhance(1.2)
        new_path = img_path.parent / f"{img_path.stem}_aug_bright1.2{img_path.suffix}"
        brightened.save(new_path, format=img.format or 'PNG')
        return new_path
